The Abu Dhabi Youth Council collaborated with Tenaris to connect local talent to opportunities in industrial success.


Tenaris


Abu Dhabi Youth Council, a government body that empowers young Emiratis to engage in leadership and public policy, collaborated with Tenaris as part of its Summer Camp Program, alongside the Federal Youth Authority, Mawahib under the Department of Government Enablement (DGE), and In-Country Value (ICV) team. The initiative highlighted how advanced manufacturing, local investment, and long-term partnerships are helping shape the UAE's industrial future and create opportunities for local talent.


“As members of the Abu Dhabi Youth Council, we believe empowering youth begins with connecting them to the UAE’s industrial success. By understanding In-Country Value and resilient supply chains, young people are inspired to become future entrepreneurs, innovators, and leaders driving the nation’s sustainable economic growth," said **Fatima Al Suwaidi** , Project leader and a member of Abu Dhabi Youth Council.


Presenters introduced the In-Country Value (ICV) program, emphasizing its capacity to strengthen the local industrial ecosystem.


Tenaris


During the session, representatives from Abu Dhabi Youth Council and ICV team introduced participants to the objectives of the ICV program and its role in strengthening the UAE's industrial ecosystem.


Tenaris shared the evolution of its presence in the UAE, spanning more than 35 years, and how this long-term commitment led to the development of Etihad Tubulars—its state-of-the-art industrial complex in Abu Dhabi.
Today, the site is home to the UAE's first industrial complex for premium OCTG threading, combining advanced manufacturing, digital technologies, a dedicated training center and integrated services to support the country's energy industry while creating local value. Participants also toured the facility, gaining insight into its automated operations, safety culture, and advanced production processes.


Attendees toured Etihad Tubulars—Tenaris's state-of-the-art industrial complex in Abu Dhabi.


Tenaris


"We are proud of the trust we have built with our long-standing partner in the UAE over more than three decades, a relationship that has given us the confidence to continue investing in the country and grow alongside its industrial ambitions," said **Lucas Rocha** , President of Tenaris in Middle East & Asia. "Our commitment goes beyond local manufacturing. By investing in technology, developing local capabilities and sharing our expertise, we are contributing to a stronger industrial ecosystem that creates long-term value for the UAE.”


Beyond its industrial footprint, Tenaris continues to support the development of local capabilities through knowledge transfer and technical training. Since 2020, the company has delivered more than 1,900 hours of technical training to local customers in Abu Dhabi, strengthening expertise across OCTG engineering, manufacturing and field applications while contributing to the UAE's long-term industrial development.
